newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ad group Euro RSCG plans worldwide expansion.
newsitem.headline: Ad group Euro RSCG plans worldwide expansion.

text.p: The New York headquarters of advertising group Euro RSCG has approved funds for wider investment, paving the way for worldwide expansion, German unit chief executive Gerhard Schoeps said on Monday.
"This investment (also) creates the foundation for greater development in Germany," Schoeps told Reuters. He declined to provide financial details.
Schoeps said that the German unit did not expect any changes in leadership, despite a flurry of recent departures by top executives.

He confirmed that Euro RSCG, which is a unit of France's Havas Advertising, had won the account for a brand-name campaign for Henninger Braeu, although the brewery's main account will stay with the German Bates unit.
Schoeps said a new contract with French jewellery house Cartier had not yet been signed. The current contract runs out at the end of the year.
